text:
maria_cs: Heads-up: onboarding tenant 'glimmer' seeing rapid 429s during SDK warmup in a WebWorker environment. Customer says it only reproduces when multiple workers boot.
ops-bot: Alert: preflight_storm tenant=glimmer concurrent_prefetch=9 :warning:
eli_se: any short logs or headers? need the minimal repro to advise.
maria_cs: sharing trimmed log (redacted):
```
[2026-04-02T08:02:10Z] worker-1 preflight /v1/prefetch auth=tokA ttl=15s
[2026-04-02T08:02:10Z] worker-2 preflight /v1/prefetch auth=tokB ttl=15s
[2026-04-02T08:02:10Z] gateway: counted 2 preflights -> quota hit 429
```
maria_cs: header dump shows both `Authorization` and `X-User-Token` present; their wrapper sets X-User-Token per worker.
zoe_sdk: likely causes: very short ephemeral ttl + multiple workers each refreshing independently + wrapper adds extra header so server treats them as distinct identities. Quick SDK fixes: in-process singleflight per origin for 300ms, TTL leeway (treat <5s as expired) and doc guidance for workers.
eli_se: agree. Can we ship a canary with singleflight + jitter? fast PR helps.
zoe_sdk: will open PR and feature-flag it: collapseRefresh=true. link when ready.
ian_infra: infra mitigation: we can temporarily raise tenant preflight quota 10->40 for 8h and add gateway soft-rule to prefer `Authorization` when duplicate headers detected. Need CS ok.
maria_cs: customer on pilot; please apply temporary bump. I created ticket ONB-1072 and attached logs. Plan: (1) infra quota bump (ian), (2) SDK canary + customer test (zoe), (3) monitor for 6h and roll RC/backport. I'll update customer.
ops-bot: Note: quota overrides will be audited.
maria_cs: thanks team — tagging owners: @zoe_sdk (SDK PR), @ian_infra (quota), @eli_se (eng review). Closing when metrics stable. :white_check_mark:
